source: research/06-requests.json, translated to ViewSpec v1. Reply and note fields dropped because they quoted brief text.
itemIndex: expect.items are Item.index values (raw recap.doc.items positions) in display order across all sections.

expected.apply: The model returns ops whose result renders expect.items (or expect.groups). The engine fixture checks spec directly.
expected.not_supported: The model returns not_supported with expect.reason. The spec must not change.
expected.refuse: Hostile. The spec must not change, whatever the model returns.
